description.value: Camp Café occupies a heritage building in Silverton (constructed between 1903 and 1906) and serves freshly baked grab-and-go food made with local, organic, and farm-fresh ingredients. Situated at the gateway to Valhalla Provincial Park on the shores of Slocan Lake, it positions itself as a launching point for outdoor adventures and explicitly describes itself as bike friendly. Staff can provide maps and day-trip inspiration for cyclists exploring the surrounding Slocan Valley.
